blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla has placed a P50 million bounty for Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa who is now considered armed and dangerous. “As of today, Sen. Bato will be considered armed and dangerous. We are placing a bounty of P50 million for his capture,” Remulla told reporters at a press briefing in Camp Crame on Friday. READ: ICC confirms arrest warrant vs Bato dela Rosa The International Criminal Court (ICC) issued a warrant of arrest against dela Rosa for his role as the national police chief during then-President Rodrigo Duterte’s bloody anti-drug campaign.
